reviews.text:
Incredible service! They've been treating my cats and my dog ​​for many years, and the service is always excellent. Even my chubby dog, who's prone to illness, is a frequent visitor. The staff is incredibly well-trained, and no matter which doctor sees you, they're always very professional. And it doesn't matter what day or time it is; if you have an emergency, they'll take care of you without hesitation.
Congratulations!

The doctor is fantastic! Very empathetic and clearly knowledgeable and experienced! The doctors and staff in general are all very nice. The only reason I'm deducting a star is that they're not transparent about the costs. They give you one price and then another, and you're stuck paying anyway. That's not cool.
They're the best, superhuman in every way. Ceci's kindness and patience are a 10 out of 10 ❤️
Excellent and professional service.
Dr. Antonio and Dr. Alberto are the best veterinarians in Guadalajara. They're accurate in their diagnoses and treatments; they really know what they're doing, and that's priceless. Thank you 😊 …

Conscientious, objective, kind, fairly priced, and with great warmth and attention for your pet, they make them feel confident...for me, the best!!
Thank you so much, Dr. Antonio 🙏🏻 …

I highly recommend Dr. Antonio Ladrón de Guevara. He's very knowledgeable, performs thorough checkups, and it's clear he truly cares about animals. I have a very sensitive cat, and he always treats him with affection. I know he's in good hands with Dr. Antonio.

As many have mentioned, be careful with the prices. I called to ask about a medication and they quoted me $20 per pill (at other high-end places it costs between $10-$15). I agreed because of the urgency, and when my husband arrived to pay, they charged him $50. I find this very abusive, unethical, and lacking in transparency. I wouldn't trust them with my pets' health.

They treat the dogs with so much love and are very reasonable with their prices, especially when your dog needs a long and delicate treatment. They explain everything to you over and over again. They are very patient with me, especially when I arrive worried because my pet is very sick.
They've had my complete trust for years, even though my little dog thinks differently.

They have years of experience, but above all, the warmth with which they treat patients and owners is admirable. Their organization and communication make for a 1000-star experience; it's a shame there's only room for 5 stars here.
Excellent treatment and professional care (not from interns) for pets. Accurate diagnoses. I highly recommend them.
Excellent, attentive and professional service.
The best doctor in Guadalajara, 100% recommended and certified, very professional.
Excellent service.
They provide excellent care! I took my dog ​​in to see what could be done... and the only option left was to put him to sleep... they were very gentle with me... thank you!
The best doctor in the whole wide world! And his medical team is also super professional!
Excellent service and care for the animals!!
Excellent team of veterinarians led by Dr. Antonio Ladrón de Guevara. Experience, empathy, knowledge, respect, and love for animals!! Thank you!
They are very honest in their work; you can tell they love our furry friends and know how to explain everything about your pet's problem. Highly recommended.
Excellent veterinarian

The best veterinarian in Guadalajara.
The staff is highly qualified, caring, and friendly. It's a place where your pet's well-being is a priority.
Dr. Antonio and Dr. Alberto provided excellent care. I've had my pets treated by them for over 20 years. They are kind, warm, and clear.

Your pet is treated as the most important thing; you take a back seat. And that's very satisfying. The doctors and nurses have such a positive energy that even the sensitive pavement feels it. My dog ​​rested his head on Dr. Antonio and Dr. Puig's chests while they examined him. It was a memorable moment.
They are clear and direct with their diagnoses.
She has been our veterinarian for over 30 years, excellent service.
The best veterinarians in Guadalajara

Dr. Karen is the best; she always answers my questions in a kind and patient way. I always take my kittens to her because she treats them very well and quickly resolves any situation I have with my kitties.
Excellent service 🐕‍🦺 and very reasonable prices …
Price but is the best vet in gdl
A negligent doctor with incorrect diagnoses that caused the patient's death; this clinic is not recommended for cats. Ordinary dogs might also have a problem with this type of doctor.

Bad experience. The staff isn't as qualified as they used to be, and the emergency service was terrible. I took my dog ​​in, and they gave me the wrong diagnosis. They said it was a lung problem, and I had to take her to another vet because I wasn't convinced by the diagnosis. Unfortunately, it turned out to be a heart problem. They never did an electrocardiogram, and she also had a minor stroke. They did some blood tests and told me they took x-rays, but unfortunately, a lot of time was lost before she could receive the proper care. 😔

My deepest respect to the doctor; he treats the dogs with such incredible love and warmth! I loved the clinic, and as an animal rescuer, I know almost all the famous veterinary clinics, but this one was truly special.
Excellent service.
The best service 👌🫶 …
The best care my dogs have ever received, all the staff are super nice and Dr. Ladrón de Guevara provides the best care.
Extremely professional and friendly
